summary: Zentek Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting the closing of a brokered LIFE offering for gross proceeds of C$18 million. The offering involved the sale of 18 million units at C$1.00 per unit, each unit consisting of one common share and one warrant exercisable at C$1.50 for three years. The company intends to use proceeds for graphite project development, ZenGUARD commercialization, and working capital. This is a routine capital-raising transaction, not a special situation.
